decisions.identity: Single 200-card February 1997 original Pinnacle flagship; NOT separate 1997 New Pinnacle, Pinnacle Certified, Totally Certified, Inside, Mint, or X-Press. Planned second series was replaced by separate 1997 New Pinnacle.
decisions.base: 200 numbered entries, Rookies 156–185, Clout 186–197, Checklist 198–200; BCP source and CollectionCount independently match card for card without subject-number discrepancies; no true RC badges.
decisions.packaging: Hobby and retail: 10 cards per pack, 24 packs per box; MSRP 2.49. Magazine: 7 per pack, 24 per box; MSRP 1.99. Draft uses standard hobby 10/24.
decisions.museum: Full 200-card base parallel, Dufex effect radiates from diamond, 1:9 hobby/retail, 1:13 magazine.
decisions.artists: One 200-card Artist's Proof master group fractured into NON-overlapping color groups: 125 Bronze, 50 Silver, 25 Gold. Exact subject-to-color identity from PP1–PP200 source checklist; #200 Trey Beamon marked CL by BCP, confirmed Bronze by TCDB. #135 Darren Fletcher BCP typo corrected to base Darrin Fletcher. Gold has announced print run 300 each and is not serial numbered. Aggregate AP insertion 1:47 hobby/retail and 1:55 magazine; do not divide these odds equally across color tiers or fabricate 200 for each.
decisions.inserts: Five actual insert sets: Cardfrontations 20 hobby-only (1:23); Home/Away 24 magazine-only (1:33; odd Away and even Home); Passport to the Majors 25 hobby/retail (1:36); Shades 10 retail-only (1:23); Team Pinnacle 10 hobby/retail (1:90; NL/front Dufex and AL/back plain); card 10 is all 18 subjects. No reversed Dufex Team Pinnacle printing. Sample promo cards excluded.
decisions.pressPlate: Eight authentic 1/1 printing plate variants (front/back times cyan, magenta, yellow, black) for all 200 base cards and all 10 Shades inserts: 210x8=1680 unique objects. These are categorically NOT base set paper parallels in 1997 Pinnacle hobby/retail packs: they were given with sealed CASES of the distinct 1997 New Pinnacle issue as prize previews. Modeled as non-pack collector items (eight sets of 200 and eight of 10) with card number inherited from plate's source for tracking, unique within ProductSet. Handwritten plate identifiers and exact one-of-one print runs are real. Never pull them in standard packs.
decisions.scans: Do not generate imagined era photos, invented layouts, reversed Team Pinnacle patterns, fake diecut silhouettes or imaginary press plates. Authentic scans/pack/box art pending production QA.
decisions.odds: Original historical format-specific frequencies verified. All productSet oddsPerPack intentionally NULL because this product models combined hobby/retail availability and cannot exclude retail Shades or magazine Home/Away, or honor non-pack Press Plate Preview distribution and fractured AP tier frequencies. Release blocked until proper pack collation.
decisions.safety: Product released:false, packPriceCents 0 and images null; no changes to existing VCS cards, prices or images. The new item is available to Admin review and not in store.

productSets.name: Base Set
productSets.notes: Original single series #1–200; Rookies #156–185, Clout #186–197, Checklists #198–200; no notable true rookie cards.

productSets.name: Museum Collection
productSets.notes: All 200 base cards, Dufex sunray from gold diamond, 1:9 hobby/retail, 1:13 magazine.
productSets.derivedVariant: Museum Collection; authentic Dufex rays from diamond, logo on card back; no serial numbering

productSets.name: Artist's Proof — Bronze
productSets.notes: Only 125 specified base identities, individually assigned Bronze Dufex tiers by checklist; 1997 Pinnacle APs share combined 1:47 hobby odds.

productSets.name: Artist's Proof — Silver
productSets.notes: Only 50 specified identities, silver Dufex; do not fabricate 200 Silver cards.

productSets.name: Artist's Proof — Gold
productSets.notes: Only 25 select base identities, Gold Dufex, announced print run 300 copies each but NOT serial numbered.

productSets.name: Cardfrontations
productSets.notes: Dual-front peel-and-reveal hitter vs pitcher; 1:23 hobby packs only.

productSets.name: Home/Away
productSets.notes: Die-cut home/away jerseys; odd numbers Away, even Home; 1:33 magazine-exclusive (7 card packs).

productSets.name: Passport to the Majors
productSets.notes: Black folding die-cut passport; 1:36 hobby/retail packs. Samples excluded.

productSets.name: Shades
productSets.notes: Mirror mylar sunglasses die-cut; 1:23 retail only. Source for Shades Press Plate Previews.

productSets.name: Team Pinnacle
productSets.notes: Dual-sided NL Dufex front, AL no-Dufex back; 1:90 hobby/retail, #10 all 18 subjects; no reversed foil version.
